Rustpick

A headless Twitch drops miner, ported from TwitchDropsMiner. It watches drop-enabled channels without video, switches when one goes offline or a higher-priority game appears, and claims drops as they complete.

Tabs

  • Main — login, live status, websocket health, mining progress, output log, and the channel list. Click a channel and press Switch to pin it; press Esc to unpin.
  • Inventory — every campaign and its drops, with progress and account-link status. Use the filters to hide categories.
  • Settings — priority and exclude lists, priority mode, and connection options. Most changes apply on the next reload.

Login

Device-code only: open the shown link, enter the code on Twitch, and approve. No password is ever entered here.

Tray

Closing the window shuts the miner down cleanly. The tray icon offers Show window and Quit.

Priority modes

  • Priority list only — mine strictly in the order of the priority list.
  • Ending soonest first — prefer campaigns closest to ending.
  • Low availability first — prefer campaigns offered by the fewest channels.

Files (settings.json, auth.json, log.txt) live in the working directory, or in $RUSTPICK_DIR. auth.json holds your Twitch token — treat it like a password.
